Transport Minister Anthony Loke resigns as Najib returns home to begin house arrest
Najib taken for scheduled dental examination after leaving Kajang Prison, Anthony Loke says

headline: Former Prime Minister Najib Razak Remains In Custody Following Shift
seoTitle: Najib Razak Returns To Prison After House Arrest Confusion
metaDescription: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak returns to Kajang Prison as political developments follow reports of a shift to house arrest.
aiSummaryBullets: Former Prime Minister Najib Razak was transported from Kajang Prison for a scheduled medical appointment.
Transport Minister Anthony Loke announced his resignation following reports regarding the transition of Najib's sentence to house arrest.
The Attorney General's Chambers requested a deferment of the house arrest, leading to Najib's return to the prison facility.
aiContextParagraph: The status of former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak has been subject to conflicting reports regarding his transition from prison to house arrest. Initially, reports emerged that Najib had exited Kajang Prison to begin serving his sentence under home confinement. This development prompted Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi to publicly reference a prior pledge made by Transport Minister Anthony Loke to resign if the house arrest took place. Following this, Anthony Loke officially announced his resignation from the cabinet. However, subsequent updates clarified that Najib was taken from prison for a dental examination and later returned to the facility. The Attorney General's Chambers ultimately requested a deferment of the house arrest order, resulting in his continued incarceration at Kajang Prison. The situation remains a focal point of public discourse as the legal and political implications of his sentencing continue to develop within the administration.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction due to the high profile of the former Prime Minister and the concurrent resignation of a sitting cabinet minister, driving a surge in public search interest.
